comment: The panel prints Freq and LvL over the knob rows and the words Just one beside the switch, while configParam names them Freq, Spread and GENERAL SWITCH (src/L-Random.cpp:70 to 81); the panel is followed and the disagreement named in each line. The four column Freq knobs are configured with a minimum of 1 and a default of 0 (src/L-Random.cpp:72 to 75), so a fresh module starts them below their own range and the timer interval is zero. The hold interval is the setting times 50ms (src/L-Random.cpp:242) measured on std::chrono::steady_clock rather than on the sample clock. The bipolar knob value is multiplied by 0.44 before use (src/L-Random.cpp:203 and 215) but a bipolar CV is not, because the CV assignment happens after that line. In Just one mode the spread_2, spread_3 and spread_4 values are computed and then never used, and the unipolar outputs take the absolute value of the single drawn number doubled (src/L-Random.cpp:261).
